title: Otra vez mañana
desc: Being told to come back, and coming back
setting: Third day at the same office. The same woman, the same folder, a new missing paper.

steps.speaker: Empleada
steps.es: Le falta la copia de la cédula.
steps.en: You are missing the copy of your ID card.

options.es: Ideay, si eso me lo pidieron ayer y aquí lo traje.
options.en: Ideay, but they asked me for that yesterday and I brought it.
options.feedback: Ideay carries the frustration without an accusation in it. She can look again without losing face.
True, and flat. It sounds like her word against yours, which is a fight you cannot win at a window.

options.es: Esta es la tercera vez que vengo.
options.en: This is the third time I have come.
options.feedback: She knows. Counting the trips out loud makes you the problem in the room.

steps.speaker: Empleada
steps.es: Déjeme ver otra vez. ¿Cómo se llama usted?
steps.en: Let me look again. What is your name?

options.es: Con mucho gusto. Se lo repito despacio.
options.en: Gladly. I will say it again slowly.
options.feedback: Foreign surnames get written wrong at every window in this country. Offering to repeat it slowly saves the fourth trip.

options.en: My name is what it says there.
options.feedback: Unhelpful. If it is spelled wrong there, that is exactly the problem.

options.es: Ya se lo dije dos veces.
options.en: I have already told you twice.
options.feedback: You have, and saying so buys you nothing but a slower search.

steps.speaker: Empleada
steps.es: Ah, aquí está. Estaba en otro expediente.
steps.en: Ah, here it is. It was in another file.

options.en: That is good. Thank you for looking.
options.feedback: She found her own office's mistake. Thanking her is cheap and it will be remembered.
Honest relief. It also lands a little like an accusation.
Smug, and she is the person who has to stamp it.

steps.speaker: Empleada
steps.es: Se lo entrego el viernes. Aquí a las nueve.
steps.en: I will hand it to you on Friday. Here at nine.

options.es: El viernes a las nueve. Aquí estaré.
options.en: Friday at nine. I will be here.
options.feedback: Repeating the day and the time back is how an appointment becomes real. It also puts it on the record.
Accepted. Without repeating it back, Friday can quietly become the following week.

options.en: And what if it is not ready?
options.feedback: You have just told her you expect her to fail. She will remember it on Friday.
